scope: Composed JavaScript race with original physics, AI, contacts, bonuses and timers. A test-only route follower supplies ordinary analog controls. No poses, velocities, triggers, pickups, timers, or physics tables are changed. This is not an original Windows full-process comparison or a full-campaign UI run.
startPolicy: Default active-grid constructor, matching the72-case baseline scope. Authored opening/countdown excluded; route controls begin on first movement-active tick. No runtime phase or timer writes.
testDriverPolicy: Globally fixed closed original road-node line with recorded turn penalty and nodes; look-ahead starts from projection onto the chosen lane segment rather than the road center; detour planner disabled; production obstacles and collision responses remain active. Ordinary inputs only.
